brief: Goldman sales-trading note on 14 Oct 2026 lists four forces converging that day. Fed commentary had been mixed heading into CPI and the desk said the market was underpricing further hikes through 2027, with December hike odds at about 88%. AI funding concerns centered on the equity capital market cycle and credit and funding conditions for Neoclouds, with CoreWeave (CRWV) questions elevated. Semis lacked EPS-driven relief despite earnings beats this quarter: ASML fell 3.94% in New York, semis fell for a sixth straight session, and Mag7 positioning has crept higher even as three-month implied vols sit near multi-year lows, meaning hedging into earnings and year-end is cheap relative to the risk. Stagflationary pressures continue building, with Goldman's Stagflation Pair (GSPUSTAG) posting its largest YTD move. On the desk itself, client activity was underwhelming but anxiety was high; tech sell skew hit a four-week high, the Low Quality/Junk basket dropped 4.5% (the day's only greater-than-3-standard-deviation factor move) while the Quality Pair is up 13.6% over a month, and the SPX ex-AI basket outperformed, up 61bps, a top-five YTD move versus the index.
